column1: # Manual pulse-count reference log (Stage 3). Copy to recordings/reference.csv and fill in.
# session_id  : the recording folder name under recordings/ (e.g. session_20261012_140000)
# condition   : one of  resting | after_exercise | dim_light | head_movement
# ref_hr_bpm  : (beats counted) * 60 / (seconds counted).  e.g. 34 beats in 30 s -> 68
# t_sec       : seconds into the recording when you took the count (blank -> compared to session median)
# Tip: count your wrist/neck pulse for 30 s twice and average. For after_exercise
#      HR falls fast -- count ASAP and note t_sec so it matches the right moment.
